name: Fresh Oranges & Grapefruit Segments (Acidic Trigger Warning)
whyItWorks: Citrus fruits contain high concentrations of free citric acid and tough fibrous pith/membrane walls. The acidity directly burns open mucosal ulcers in the stomach and small intestine, stimulating painful hypermotility and urgent diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger Warning: Avoid fresh oranges, clementines, and grapefruit during active IBD. If eating in remission, supreme the orange (cut away all white pith and translucent membranes) or choose low-acid canned mandarin oranges in water.
watchOuts: Violates FlareWise Citrus-Free guardrail. Strong acidic stimulation triggers severe burning cramping and reflux.
